build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball on an obstacle and a jar with a ball inside
create_define_task_template: create a parameterized task template using define_task_template with radius, jar_scale, angle, and search_params
add_scene_objects: add static bars, dynamic jars, and dynamic balls to the PHYRE scene using C.add
update_task_relationships: update the task goal to require two bodies to be touching using C.update_task
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL using C.set_meta
